🗯️ Morning Boost | Employers/HR · Tuesday

Say the hard thing plainly today instead of softening it into confusion.

Over-softened messages often leave people more confused about where they actually stand.
State the difficult point directly, pair it with context or support, or simply avoid unnecessary hedging.
I will communicate one difficult point plainly and directly today.
Affirmation: "Kindness and clarity aren't opposites. Vagueness dressed up as kindness usually isn't kind."
♻️ If your team is navigating this right now, I'd be glad to help you think it through.
